$comment: Composition contract for the Home screen at desktop. Originally measured from the concept spec in source pixels; since the accounts-era rearrangement (user decision 2026-08-04, the only layout since Phase F) the right rail deviates deliberately from the concept: the signed-in badge and recovery-access panel are retired, the profile panel holds the top-right slot, and activity/rail-extra spread over the freed space. Regions become percent rects (rect / sourceSize) consumed by BOTH the home CSS region rects in arcade-kit.css and e2e/tests/arcade-regions.spec.ts.
